name: standing half kneeling hip flexors stretch
description: A half-kneeling position that opens the front of the hip and the quad of the back leg.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a pad under your knee.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis under.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
